Ramayana Cast Joins Amitabh Bachchan on KBC 18 for Festive Special

Star-Studded Festive Preview

Actors Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi, and Ravie Dubey recently appeared on 'Kaun Banega Crorepati 18' to promote Nitesh Tiwari’s upcoming cinematic adaptation of the *Ramayana*. During the Diwali special episode, host Amitabh Bachchan shared childhood anecdotes, joking about a competitive 'firecracker rivalry' with his neighbors, which entertained the guest stars.

Project Outlook

Directed by Nitesh Tiwari, the high-budget production features Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama and Sai Pallavi as Goddess Sita. The film is planned as a two-part event, with the first installment scheduled for theatrical release on November 5, 2026, and the second installment expected to follow in 2027. Viewers can watch the full KBC 18 episode on Sony Entertainment Television at 9:00 PM.
